summary: A cheerful primary-colour playroom lit by daylight from a wide window: pale blue walls hung with party bunting and wall stickers, two shelves and a bulletin board with coat hooks along the back wall, a tall white storage shelf and an open wooden toy chest with a draped scarf on the left, a red-and-yellow circus play tent at the centre with its flaps tied open, a round red activity table and two blue chairs sitting in front of the tent on a red-and-white target rug, a sunny window with yellow curtains and two potted plants on the right beside a picture-book display rack and a green bean bag chair, an open wooden crate cropped in the front-right corner, and two floor cushions on warm wood-plank flooring filling the foreground.
camera: eye level, flat two-point cartoon perspective; a wall seam splits the frame near the middle, where the paler back wall meets the sunnier window wall on the right; floor visible across the bottom half of the frame.

lighting.ambient: bright, even daylight typical of flat clip-art shading; colours are flat-filled with only soft, minimal cast shadows, and nothing in the room reads as truly dark except the tent's interior and the open chest and crate.

keySources.color: pale daylight with a hint of rainbow colour

lighting.notes: Shading is flat and cheerful with almost no directional key, so props keep their own drawn shading rather than needing to match a rake of light. Only the tent doorway, the chest and the crate are dim enough to hide a sprite by darkness alone.

palette.notes: The room is already saturated with primary red, yellow, blue and green toys - the rug, the chest scarf, the storage bins, the tent, the chairs and the bean bag - so sprites in those same primaries have many places to hide in plain sight. Pale or white props stand out against the primaries but sink into the sky-blue walls and yellow curtains; brown or wood-toned props vanish against the floor, shelves, chest and crate.

placementRules.notes: Spread finds across the whole room instead of clustering them on the table and rug, which look like the 'main' hiding spot; use the shelves, chest, tent doorway, curtains and cushions too. Never put two finds inside the same focal point (tent, window, rug centre).

regions.name: Upper-left wall shelf (books)
regions.notes: A row of picture books already stands upright on this shelf against the pale wall; a small prop tucks in beside them or leans on the shelf lip.

regions.name: Upper-middle wall shelf (books and basket)
regions.notes: Books and a folded-cloth basket already share this shelf; there is a bare patch beside the basket for one more small find.

regions.name: Bulletin board
regions.notes: Already covered in pinned notes and reminders, so one more small pinned prop reads as just another note tacked up.

regions.name: Wall coat hooks
regions.notes: Three empty pegs on a white rail below the corkboard, bare and easy to hang a small prop from.

regions.name: Left window curtain
regions.notes: Bright yellow drape pooling against the wall; a small prop tucks into a fold near the bottom.

regions.name: Right window curtain
regions.notes: Mirror of the left drape, close to the frame edge, so keep placements away from the last sliver of fabric.

regions.name: Window sill beside the blue plant pot
regions.notes: Small succulent in a blue pot on the white sill against the sunny rainbow view; a prop tucks in beside the pot.

regions.name: Window sill beside the tall plant
regions.notes: Taller potted plant close to the right curtain; keep placements left of the frame-edge margin.

regions.name: Top of the low storage shelf
regions.notes: A basket, rolled towels and a potted cactus already sit here; a small prop tucks between them.

regions.name: Storage unit open shelf
regions.notes: Books and a rolled towel share this open compartment; plenty of gaps to tuck a small prop into.

regions.name: Storage unit bin row
regions.notes: Blue, yellow and red bins fill this compartment almost completely, so a prop can only be tucked into the gaps between them, never rested flat on top.

regions.name: Open lid of the wooden toy chest
regions.notes: Bare inner face of the propped-open lid; a prop leans against it with its base on the chest rim.

regions.name: Toy chest rim and scarf
regions.notes: A green-striped scarf drapes over the front edge; a prop tucks into its folds or sits on the rim above the closed front panel.

regions.name: Play tent doorway
regions.notes: Shaded floor just inside the open tent flaps, tied back to show a dark, empty interior - the best hiding value in the room.

regions.name: Picture-book display rack
regions.notes: Slotted shelves already packed face-out with picture books; a prop tucks into a gap between the covers. Its lower right corner is partly covered by the bean bag chair.

regions.name: Green bean bag chair
regions.notes: Soft, dimpled seat with a deep central dip; a prop sits in the dip or tucks into a fold. Its lowest corner is cropped by the open crate in front.

regions.name: Round activity table
regions.notes: Bare red tabletop between the two chairs, the biggest open surface in the room and easy for a young child to spot.

regions.name: Left chair seat
regions.notes: Bare blue plastic seat and chair back; a small prop can rest on the seat or hang off the top rail.

regions.name: Right chair seat
regions.notes: Mirror of the left chair, bare seat and rail.

regions.name: Red and white target rug
regions.notes: Big ringed bullseye rug under the table, mostly pale white between the red rings. No restLine: this is a ground plane, so a prop's y is its distance from the camera.

regions.name: Open crate in the front-right corner
regions.notes: Open wooden box cropped by the frame edge in the nearest corner; a prop sits inside or leans against the raised flap.

regions.name: Blue floor cushion
regions.notes: Plump blue cushion in the near-left corner; a prop tucks into the crease against the yellow pillow beside it.

regions.name: Yellow floor cushion
regions.notes: Bright yellow cushion overlapping the blue one; light-coloured props nearly disappear into it.

regions.name: Floor beside the storage unit
regions.notes: Narrow strip of open plank floor between the storage unit and the pillows. No restLine: this is a ground plane, so a prop's y is its distance from the camera.

regions.name: Floor beside the bean bag
regions.notes: Sliver of open floor between the bean bag and the frame edge. No restLine: this is a ground plane, so a prop's y is its distance from the camera.

regions.name: Foreground floor strip
regions.notes: Nearest strip of plank floor running along the bottom of the frame between the pillows and the front crate; nothing occludes it, so props here read biggest. No restLine: this is a ground plane, so a prop's y is its distance from the camera.

viewport.notes: SceneView fills the viewport on both axes and lets the player pan the overflow, so nothing is permanently hidden by cropping. On a portrait phone only the middle third of the scene width is on screen at rest, so finds must be spread across the width rather than packed into one side.

noGo.reason: Thin party bunting strung across the top of the frame with no surface behind it; a prop here reads as floating.
Flat wall stickers (sun, cloud, bird) with no surface; a prop here reads as pasted over the art.
Bright rainbow sky view with no surface to sit on; a sprite here reads as pasted over the art.
The table's legs and skirt stand in front of the rug behind them. A prop placed there is drawn glued to the woodwork.
The backdrop's edge, and a prop straddling it looks cut off.
Mirror of the left edge bleed.
Same edge bleed along the top of the wall.
Same edge bleed along the bottom boards.
